1879060605.name: Catch a Breath
1879060605.desc: You are able to catch your breath to restore morale and power.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires a block or parry response.</rgb>

1879064061.name: Blade Wall
1879064061.desc: Make a frontal AoE attack and reduce your enemies' Physical Mitigation.

1879064189.name: Piercing Cry
1879064189.desc: Your shout does light damage to your enemies and can interrupt their actions.

1879089789.name: Misdirection
1879089789.desc: Although not capable of being invisible in the spirit world, Rangers are still known for disappearing from sight. For a short while your stealth is extremely effective.

1879109629.name: Steel Snaring Web
1879109629.desc:
A ranged attack that targets the victim's legs with sticky webs, rooting them in place.<rgb=#00ff00>
 
 Applies Ensnared Effect. 
 Stacks 3 times. 
 </rgb>

1879182845.name: Unerring Strike
1879182845.desc: A targeted strike that is very difficult to avoid and deals potent damage for a long time.

1879198333.name: Friend of Noble Birds (Ashen-eagle)
1879198333.desc: Summons an eagle companion.\n\nThe eagle is a noble creature which can deal damage and, if called upon, will sacrifice itself to save you.

1879202173.name: Sword Sweep
1879202173.desc: A powerful sword swing that damages enemies in front.

1879208701.name: Summerfest Pony
1879208701.desc: A pony from the Summer Festival.

1879212925.name: Improved Subtle Stab
1879212925.desc: A quick, sharp attack that reduces the cooldown of Mischievous Delight.

1879214589.name: The Dark Before Dawn
1879214589.desc: A Gambit which restores Power and grants some Power-over-Time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879215869.name: Inspire (Blade-brother)
1879215869.desc: A melee attack that restores a small amount of Power to your Blade-brother and increases their damage slightly.

1879221501.name: Yule Festival Frosty Horse
1879221501.desc: A horse from the Yule Festival.

1879233021.name: Fist and Javelin
1879233021.desc: Capable Wardens prepare their fist and javelin for attack.

1879240701.name: Destabilizing Strike
1879240701.desc: You call upon your inner reserve of strength to unnerve your opposition, forcing them to behave as you desire on the field of battle.

1879248381.name: Seeking Arrow - Light
1879248381.desc: Steadying your mount, you attempt a well-placed shot at an enemy that will deal Light-based damage and apply a potentially harmful effect to your target.

1879256957.name: Hedge Your Bet
1879256957.desc: After a first-step Critical Chain Skill, make a quick attack that rolls a Green gamble on you, restoring morale over time.

1879262845.name: Crippling Shot
1879262845.desc: Seeing your enemy at a distance, you instinctively let loose an arrow, catching your foe off guard. \n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Increases Fervour by 1</rgb>

1879268477.name: Chilling Sweep
1879268477.desc: A wide sweep that chills and knocks away all who stand against you!

1879272829.name: Sure Strike
1879272829.desc: An attack that cannot be blocked or parried.

1879319933.name: Feign Injury
1879319933.desc: You fake an injury just long enough to divert the enemy's attention elsewhere.

1879339133.name: Return to after-battle Osgiliath
1879339133.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Host of the West, you're able to quickly return to after-battle Osgiliath. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879389053.name: Big Bumblebee
1879389053.desc: Brings out a big bumblebee to keep you company.

1879389949.name: Soothful Vapour
1879389949.desc: It is said that this concoction will calm even the most savage beast.

1879415549.name: Extremely Subtle Portent of Strength
1879415549.desc: A quick burst of strength, increasing the amount of damage you do.

1879430269.name: Guide to Leitstáth
1879430269.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Leitstáth.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879467261.name: Sludge Pot
1879467261.desc: A pot filled with a foul-smelling sludge.

1879470589.name: The Slaying of Scatha
1879470589.desc: Sing of the Slaying of Scatha.

1879484029.name: Power of Destruction
1879484029.desc: Lightning wreaths your enemy and releases explosive bursts on enemies nearby.

1879489149.name: Harrying Strike
1879489149.desc: Your companion pecks and claws at their foe, slowing and wounding them.

1879489789.name: Battle Knowledge
1879489789.desc: Your knowledge of histories allows you to encourage your allies, recalling images of noble banners carried steadfastly into the flames of war. Creates a circle in which your allies are empowered for a time.

1879491069.name: Ruby Drakeling
1879491069.desc: Summons a friendly drakeling to accompany you on your adventures.

1879491581.name: Call to the Valar
1879491581.desc: You call upon the wisdom of the Valar, recovering some of your skills and providing a temporary immunity to induction set back from damage.\n\n<rgb=#33BCFF>Keeper of Animals:</rgb> Retribution, Catmint, Unbreakable Bond

1879516925.name: Vigilant Cobra Bauble
1879516925.desc: Place down a surprisingly realistic snake to startle your friends.

1879520637.name: Ivory Mûrai Herding Dog
1879520637.desc: Summons a hard working herding dog to accompany you on your travels.

1879523197.name: The Effigy of The Witch-king
1879523197.desc: Summon an effigy of The Witch-king, doomed to die shortly after it appears.

1879525373.name: Soaring Pinwheel Fireworks
1879525373.desc: Set off a spinning pinwheel of fireworks!
